components.provenance: Living-native current-location, breadcrumb, selection, debounced announcement and focus-recovery accessibility projection. It preserves canonical aria-pressed rail semantics while adding aria-current, and never routes native input or mutates canonical selection, scale, camera, persistence or science state.

Bounded sparse discovery wrapper around existing Living searchWorlds and enterKey APIs. It caps rows and pages, supports cancellation, rejects stale cross-system results, preserves continuation cursors and never enumerates the universe or directly mutates canonical selection.
Lane-owned skip-link, structured-current-context, compact safe-area, 44px+ audio targets, explicit focus-visible and scoped reduced-motion styling. No product truth or input authority.
